definitions.primary_label: PROVISIONAL (rule winner of one of nine; not validated, not shown superior)

noise_bases.phase4_kish: sigma2_within / n_eff_kish (the Phase 4 estimator as implemented)
noise_bases.match_cluster: cluster-robust variance of the player mean with matches as clusters

bowler_signal_candidates.label: SENSITIVITY_ONLY: does not replace the primary definition and never feeds the API

candidates.description: Batting side ahead of the bowling side's defence: chase rows with projected_surplus at or above the TRAIN q0.75 of chase rows; innings-1 rows with the batting side's runs above the STRICTLY PRIOR par at or above the TRAIN q0.75 of that deviation. Per format.
Chase rows in the death phase where the absolute rate gap |rrr - crr| is at or below the TRAIN q0.25 of that quantity among chase death rows. Per format.

Death-phase rows (both innings) where the batting side's wickets remaining are at or above the TRAIN q0.75 of wickets remaining among death rows. Per format. Wording note: the design text said 'wickets-in-hand at or below'; the bowler is under pressure when the batting side has MANY wickets in hand, so the upper quantile is used.

stability.context_eligibility: context-specific working pool: the P50 candidate threshold of the context's own TRAIN ball counts (same derivation as the Phase 4 working pool). NOT validated.
